outcome: quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC)
cohort: Women who gave birth in a Belgian facility between March 1, 2020, and May 1, 2023, and responded to a validated online questionnaire.
finding: The study found generally high quality of maternal and newborn care (QMNC) scores in Belgium during the COVID-19 pandemic, but identified specific gaps in all domains and noted lower QMNC scores for women with instrumental vaginal births, while 'experience of care' and 'key organisational changes due to COVID-19' scores significantly increased over time.
mod_finding: Women who experienced an instrumental vaginal birth had significantly lower quality of maternal and newborn care scores compared to other modes of birth.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women who gave birth between March 1, 2020, and May 1, 2023.
